# Germany: Iraqi couple jailed for enslaving, raping Yazidi girls

*Published: April 5, 2018*

A Munich court has imprisoned an Iraqi couple for enslaving and raping two Yazidi girls. The court handed down the sentences after a four-month trial.

The Munich Regional Court sentenced Taha Al-J. to life in prison after finding him guilty of crimes against humanity, war crimes and several counts of rape. The man's German-Iraqi wife, identified as Jennifer W. due to German privacy laws, received a suspended sentence for being an accessory to crimes against humanity.

The Yazidi girls, who were between 10 and 13 years old when they were sold to the couple, were enslaved by the Islamic State (IS) in Iraq and Syria. Taha Al-J. was one of IS's leading members.

Jennifer W. was also convicted on charges of attempted murder, after the court heard she had watched as one of the girls, an 8-year-old, was chained outside in the heat without water until she collapsed and died.

The trial began in October 2017.

</tool_response>
